'''Pyrewood Watchers''' are [[human]]s located in [[Pyrewood Village]] in [[Silverpine Forest]] during the day. At night, they transform into their [[worgen]] form as '''[[Moonrage Watcher]]s'''.

==Abilities==
* '''Shoot''' — Shoots at an enemy, inflicting Physical damage.

==Objective of==
* Drop [[Pyrewood Shackle]] for {{questlong|Horde|15+|Arugal's Folly (4)|Arugal's Folly}}.

==Notes==
* They are affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during daytime to make them unattackable by Alliance players.
